BiblicalUsage: Folly is charged even to angels. Eliphaz says God put no trust in His servants, and His angels He charged with folly — and if that is true of angels, what is true of men?
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the humility is the point: no creature stands before God on its own wisdom.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
